google_compute_shared_vpc_host_project.shared_vpc_host invokes the Compute Engine API, but does not wait for google_project_service.project_services to enable it. When compute.googleapis.com is managed here, host enablement can race API activation, and destruction can race API shutdown.

google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project.shared_vpc_service configures a Compute Engine Shared VPC service project without waiting for google_project_service.project_services. When this module manages compute.googleapis.com, attachment can race activation and detachment can race API shutdown.

google_project_iam_member.shared_vpc_host_robots constructs service-agent email addresses without waiting for google_project_service_identity.jit_si. For configured Pub/Sub, Secret Manager, or Cloud Asset service agents, the IAM grant can run before the just-in-time identity exists.

fix.expression: each.value.service == "cloudservices" ? "serviceAccount:${local.service_account_cloud_services}" : "serviceAccount:${merge(local.service_accounts_robots, { for api, sa in google_project_service_identity.jit_si : trimsuffix(api, ".googleapis.com") => sa.email }, { for sa in data.google_storage_project_service_account.gcs_sa : "storage" => sa.email_address }, { for sa in data.google_bigquery_default_service_account.bq_sa : "bq" => sa.email })[each.value.service]}"

google_essential_contacts_contact.contact uses the Essential Contacts API without waiting for google_project_service.project_services. When essentialcontacts.googleapis.com is enabled for this project by the module, contact creation can race activation and deletion can race API shutdown.

google_project_iam_member.shared_vpc_host_robots grants roles to service-agent email addresses synthesized from the project number, but has no dependency on google_project_service.project_services. For agents provisioned by API activation, such as Compute Engine or GKE agents, the IAM grant can race the activation that creates the principal. Wait for the managed services; lazily generated identities additionally require their identity resource or lookup.
